board_events.text: (i) hCG is secreted by the PLACENTA - specifically the trophoblast-derived tissue - and it is produced ONLY during pregnancy.
(ii) Because hCG appears only when an IMPLANTED, placenta-forming pregnancy exists, its presence in urine is a SPECIFIC marker; non-pregnant women do not produce it.
(iii) Very early after conception, the placenta is just forming and hCG levels may be BELOW the strip's detection threshold - so the test can read negative even though conception has occurred.
Answer: placental origin; pregnancy-specific production; false negative from sub-threshold hCG if tested too early.
The deeper point: the strip does not detect conception. It detects a PLACENTA. That gap in time is the whole explanation.
Common student pitfalls in this subtopic
1. The morula is NOT bigger than the zygote. Cleavage adds cells, not size. Remember: 'more bags, same luggage.'
2. Trophoblast vs inner cell mass. Trophoblast = outer, attaches to endometrium (→ placenta side). Inner cell mass = inner, becomes the embryo. Do not swap their fates.
3. Where fertilisation happens. It is the AMPULLARY-ISTHMIC JUNCTION of the oviduct - NOT the uterus. The uterus is where implantation occurs.
4. Germ-layer derivatives get mixed up. Anchor three: nervous system and epidermis = ECTODERM; muscles, bone, blood = MESODERM; gut and respiratory lining, liver = ENDODERM.
5. Parturition is POSITIVE feedback. Oxytocin amplifies contractions - one of the few textbook examples of positive (not negative) feedback in human physiology.
Pro-Tip (speed + accuracy): carry two mantras
DEVELOPMENT ORDER: 'Zygote, Cleave, Morula, Blast, Implant' - five beats, in order.
GERM LAYERS: 'Ecto = covering + nerves, Meso = movement + skeleton + blood, Endo = inner linings + gut glands.'
Most sequence and derivative questions fall instantly to these two.
Everything, in the order the body uses it

ANATOMY - Gonads do two jobs: testis → sperms + androgens; ovary → ova + ovarian hormones. Everything else is accessory. Testis nesting: testis ⊃ ~250 lobules ⊃ 1-3 seminiferous tubules ⊃ spermatogonia + Sertoli INSIDE, Leydig OUTSIDE. Kept 2-2.5 degrees C cooler in the scrotum.

ROUTES - Male: tubule → rete testis → vasa efferentia → epididymis → vas deferens → ejaculatory duct → urethra. Female: ovary → fimbriae → infundibulum → ampulla (fertilisation) → isthmus → uterus → cervix → vagina. Semen = seminal plasma (fructose, calcium, enzymes) + sperms.
STRUCTURES - Uterine wall (out→in): Perimetrium · Myometrium · Endometrium. 'PME - Protects, Moves, Embeds.' Mammary drainage: alveoli → mammary tubules → mammary ducts → ampulla → lactiferous duct.

GAMETOGENESIS - Yields are opposite: 1 primary spermatocyte → 4 sperms; 1 primary oocyte → 1 ovum + polar bodies. Chromosome ladder (both sexes): 2n → 2n → n → n; the halving is at MEIOSIS I. Order: spermatogonium → primary → secondary spermatocyte → spermatid → (spermiogenesis) → spermatozoon → (spermiation). Oogenesis starts in the foetus (arrest at prophase I); meiosis I completes at the Graafian stage; meiosis II ONLY at fertilisation.

CYCLE - Follicles: primary → secondary → tertiary (antrum) → Graafian → ovulation (LH surge). Four phases: Menstrual (3-5 d, progesterone falls) · Follicular (~14 d, FSH/LH rise, oestrogen) · Ovulatory (~day 14, LH SURGE) · Luteal (~10 d, corpus luteum → progesterone). Sources - 'Hypothalamus Pings Pituitary, Ovary Plays Back': GnRH → FSH/LH → oestrogen/progesterone → endometrium. Menarche → menopause (~50 yr).

DEVELOPMENT - Zygote → Cleavage (no growth) → Morula (not bigger than zygote) → Blastocyst (trophoblast + inner cell mass) → Implantation → pregnancy. Fertilisation site: ampullary-isthmic junction; the sperm completes the oocyte's meiosis II; the SPERM determines sex.

PLACENTA = bridge + gland. Oxygen and nutrients in, carbon dioxide and waste out, via the umbilical cord. Secretes hCG, hPL, oestrogen, progestogens; relaxin from the OVARY (late). Mnemonic 'CHaPLeR' - hCG, hPL, Relaxin are pregnancy-ONLY.

GERM LAYERS - Ectoderm (skin, nerves, sense organs) · Mesoderm (muscle, bone, blood, kidneys) · Endoderm (gut and lung lining, liver, pancreas). Gestation ≈ 9 months; heart ~1 month, limbs/digits ~2 months, major organs ~12 weeks.

PARTURITION - foetal-ejection reflex → oxytocin (maternal pituitary) → stronger contractions → more oxytocin (POSITIVE feedback) → delivery. LACTATION - first milk = colostrum, antibody-rich (IgA) → passive immunity for the newborn.

segments.text: Example three, an N E E T assertion reason, and it is testing the exact idea we opened this part with. Same two-step discipline as always.
The assertion: the morula is not larger than the zygote despite having many cells.
The reason: cleavage involves rapid mitotic divisions without any increase in overall size.
Your four options: both true and the reason explains the assertion; both true but it does not explain; assertion true and reason false; or assertion false and reason true.
Put them side by side on the board, and, as always, keep the fact check separate from the link check.
Step one, check each statement alone. The morula really is not larger than the zygote, so the assertion is true. And cleavage really is mitosis without growth, so the reason is true.

Step two, the deciding step. Cleavage subdivides the existing cytoplasm into more, smaller cells, without growth, so total size stays roughly constant. That is not a fact sitting near the assertion. That is exactly why the assertion holds.
So the answer is option a. Option b would need the two to be unrelated facts, and here the mechanism in the reason directly produces the fact in the assertion. More bags, same luggage.
Example four, high difficulty, and a lovely one because it takes a strip you can buy in any chemist's shop and makes you explain it from the biology up. Three parts, so answer three parts.

The setup: a pregnancy-test strip detects h C G in urine. Explain, step by step, where h C G comes from, why its presence specifically indicates pregnancy, and one reason a very early test might give a false negative.
Look at the curve on the board, because part three is hiding in its left-hand end.

Part one, the origin. h C G is secreted by the placenta, specifically the trophoblast-derived tissue. And here is the property that makes the whole test possible: it is produced only during pregnancy.

Part two, the specificity. Because h C G appears only when an implanted, placenta-forming pregnancy exists, its presence in urine is a specific marker. Non-pregnant women simply do not produce it, so there is no background to confuse the reading.

Part three, the false negative, and this is where the marks are. Very early after conception, the placenta is only just forming, so h C G levels may still be below the strip's detection threshold. The test reads negative even though conception has occurred. Tested too early.
So the full answer: placental origin; pregnancy-specific production; and a false negative from sub-threshold h C G if tested too early.

<curious>And notice the deeper point the question is really after. The strip does not detect conception. It detects a placenta. Those two things happen at different times, and that gap is the entire explanation for the false negative.
Five traps take almost all the marks lost in this subtopic. Then two mantras that make the rest quick.
Trap one: the morula is not bigger than the zygote. Cleavage adds cells, not size. Remember the phrase: more bags, same luggage.

Trap two: trophoblast versus inner cell mass. Trophoblast is outer and attaches to the endometrium, so it points to the placenta side. Inner cell mass is inner, and becomes the embryo. Do not swap their fates.
Trap three: where fertilisation happens. It is the ampullary-isthmic junction of the oviduct, not the uterus. The uterus is where implantation occurs. Two acts, two addresses.

Trap four: germ-layer derivatives get mixed up. Anchor three groups. Nervous system and epidermis are ectoderm. Muscles, bone and blood are mesoderm. Gut and respiratory lining, and the liver, are endoderm.

Trap five: parturition is positive feedback. Oxytocin amplifies contractions. It is one of the few textbook examples of positive, not negative, feedback in human physiology, and the default assumption of negative feedback is exactly what the trap exploits.
Now the two mantras. Both are short enough to jot in the margin before you read the question.
Development order: zygote, cleave, morula, blast, implant. Five beats, in order. Say it as a rhythm and no sequence question can scramble you.
Germ layers: ecto is covering plus nerves; meso is movement plus skeleton plus blood; endo is inner linings plus gut glands.
Most sequence and derivative questions fall instantly to those two. That is a large block of marks for about a minute of memorising.
One board, the whole chapter, in the order the body uses it.

Anatomy. The testis makes sperms and androgens, the ovary ova and ovarian hormones; everything else is accessory. The testis nests through lobules to seminiferous tubules, Sertoli inside, Leydig outside, cooler in the scrotum.

Two routes. Male: tubule, rete testis, vasa efferentia, epididymis, vas deferens, ejaculatory duct, urethra. Female: ovary, fimbriae, infundibulum, ampulla where fertilisation happens, isthmus, uterus, cervix, vagina.
Two mnemonics. The uterine wall, outside in: perimetrium, myometrium, endometrium - protects, moves, embeds. Mammary drainage: alveoli, tubules, ducts, ampulla, lactiferous duct.

Gametogenesis. Yields are opposite: one primary spermatocyte gives four sperms; one primary oocyte gives one ovum plus polar bodies. Same ladder both sides, halving at meiosis one. Oogenesis starts before birth.
The cycle. Follicles build to the Graafian stage, then the surge releases. Four phases: menstrual, follicular, ovulatory, luteal. Sources chain: hypothalamus pings pituitary, ovary plays back.
Development. Zygote, cleavage with no growth, morula no bigger, blastocyst with its two halves, implantation, pregnancy. Fertilisation at the ampullary-isthmic junction. The sperm determines sex.
The placenta is a bridge and a gland. Oxygen and food in, carbon dioxide and waste out, via the umbilical cord. And C H a P L e R: h C G, h P L and relaxin are pregnancy-only, relaxin from the ovary.
Germ layers. Ectoderm for skin and nerves, mesoderm for muscle, bone and blood, endoderm for linings and gut glands. Gestation about nine months.

<excited>And the close. Parturition is positive feedback: reflex, oxytocin, stronger contractions, more oxytocin, delivery. Then colostrum, antibody-rich, passive immunity for the newborn. That is Human Reproduction, whole.
Example three, एक N E E T assertion reason, और ये ठीक वही idea test कर रहा है जिससे हमने ये part शुरू किया था। हमेशा वाली two-step discipline।
Assertion — morula zygote से बड़ी नहीं है, बावजूद इसके कि उसमें बहुत सी cells हैं।
Reason — cleavage में तेज़ mitotic divisions होते हैं, बिना कुल size बढ़े।
चार options — दोनों true और reason assertion को explain करता है; दोनों true लेकिन explain नहीं करता; assertion true और reason false; या assertion false और reason true।
इन्हें board पर साथ-साथ रखो, और हमेशा की तरह fact check को link check से अलग रखो।
Step one, हर statement अकेले check करो। Morula सच में zygote से बड़ी नहीं है, तो assertion true है। और cleavage सच में बिना growth वाला mitosis है, तो reason true है।

Step two, फ़ैसला करने वाला step। Cleavage मौजूदा cytoplasm को ज़्यादा, छोटी cells में बाँटता है, बिना growth के, तो कुल size लगभग वही रहता है। ये assertion के पास पड़ा कोई fact नहीं है। यही ठीक वजह है कि assertion सही है।
तो answer है option a। Option b तभी चाहिए होता जब दोनों unrelated facts होते, और यहाँ reason का mechanism सीधे assertion का fact पैदा करता है। ज़्यादा बैग, वही सामान।
Example four, high difficulty, और बहुत प्यारा, क्योंकि ये किसी भी दवा की दुकान से मिलने वाली एक strip उठाकर तुमसे biology से समझाने को कहता है। तीन हिस्से हैं, तो तीन हिस्सों में जवाब दो।

Setup — एक pregnancy-test strip urine में h C G पकड़ती है। step by step समझाओ कि h C G कहाँ से आता है, उसकी मौजूदगी ख़ास तौर पर pregnancy क्यों बताती है, और एक वजह कि बहुत जल्दी किया गया test false negative क्यों दे सकता है।
Board पर curve देखो, क्योंकि तीसरा हिस्सा उसके बाएँ सिरे में छुपा है।
पहला हिस्सा, origin। h C G placenta से निकलता है, ख़ास तौर पर trophoblast से बने tissue से। और यही वो गुण है जो पूरे test को मुमकिन बनाता है — ये सिर्फ़ pregnancy के दौरान बनता है।

दूसरा हिस्सा, specificity। चूँकि h C G तभी आता है जब एक implanted, placenta बनाती pregnancy मौजूद हो, इसलिए urine में उसकी मौजूदगी एक specific marker है। ग़ैर-गर्भवती महिलाएँ इसे बनाती ही नहीं, तो reading को उलझाने वाला कोई background नहीं है।

तीसरा हिस्सा, false negative, और marks यहीं हैं। Conception के बहुत जल्दी बाद placenta बस बन ही रहा होता है, तो h C G का level अब भी strip की detection threshold से नीचे हो सकता है। Test negative पढ़ता है जबकि conception हो चुका है। बहुत जल्दी test किया गया।
तो पूरा answer — placental origin; pregnancy-specific production; और बहुत जल्दी test करने पर threshold से नीचे h C G की वजह से false negative।
<curious>और वो गहरी बात देखो जो question असल में पूछ रहा है। Strip conception नहीं पकड़ती। वो placenta पकड़ती है। ये दोनों चीज़ें अलग-अलग समय पर होती हैं, और वही अंतराल false negative की पूरी वजह है।
पाँच traps इस subtopic में गँवाए गए लगभग सारे marks ले जाते हैं। फिर दो mantras जो बाकी सब तेज़ कर देते हैं।
Trap one — morula zygote से बड़ी नहीं है। Cleavage cells जोड़ता है, size नहीं। ये वाक्य याद रखो — ज़्यादा बैग, वही सामान।

Trap two — trophoblast बनाम inner cell mass। Trophoblast बाहरी है और endometrium से चिपकता है, तो वो placenta की तरफ़ इशारा करता है। Inner cell mass अंदरूनी है, और embryo बनता है। इनकी क़िस्में मत बदलो।
Trap three — fertilisation कहाँ होता है। ये oviduct का ampullary-isthmic junction है, uterus नहीं। Uterus वो जगह है जहाँ implantation होता है। दो acts, दो पते।

Trap four — germ-layer derivatives में घालमेल हो जाता है। तीन समूह पकड़ो। Nervous system और epidermis ectoderm हैं। Muscles, bone और blood mesoderm हैं। आँत और respiratory lining, और liver, endoderm हैं।

Trap five — parturition positive feedback है। Oxytocin contractions को बढ़ाता है। ये human physiology में positive, न कि negative, feedback के बहुत कम textbook उदाहरणों में से एक है, और negative feedback मान लेने की आदत ही वो चीज़ है जिसका trap फ़ायदा उठाता है।
अब दो mantras। दोनों इतने छोटे हैं कि question पढ़ने से पहले margin में लिख सको।
Development order — zygote, cleave, morula, blast, implant। पाँच beats, order में। इसे लय की तरह बोलो और कोई sequence question तुम्हें उलझा नहीं सकता।
Germ layers — ecto है ढकना plus nerves; meso है गति plus कंकाल plus ख़ून; endo है अंदरूनी linings plus आँत की glands।
ज़्यादातर sequence और derivative questions इन दोनों से तुरंत गिर जाते हैं। लगभग एक मिनट के रटने के बदले marks का बड़ा हिस्सा।
एक board, पूरा chapter। इसे रात पहले पढ़ो, और उसी order में पढ़ो जिसमें शरीर असल में इसे इस्तेमाल करता है, क्योंकि वही order इसे टिकाता है।

पहले anatomy। Gonads दो-दो काम करते हैं — testis sperms और androgens बनाता है, ovary ova और ovarian hormones। बाक़ी सब accessory है। Testis lobules से होते हुए seminiferous tubules तक घोंसले की तरह उतरता है, Sertoli अंदर और Leydig बाहर, scrotum में कुछ degree ठंडा रखा हुआ।

दोनों routes, एक-एक line में। Male — tubule, rete testis, vasa efferentia, epididymis, vas deferens, ejaculatory duct, urethra। Female — ovary, fimbriae, infundibulum, ampulla जहाँ fertilisation होता है, isthmus, uterus, cervix, vagina।

दो structures mnemonic के लायक़। Uterine wall, बाहर से अंदर — perimetrium, myometrium, endometrium — protects, moves, embeds। और mammary drainage चलती है alveoli, tubules, ducts, ampulla, lactiferous duct।

Gametogenesis। Yields उल्टे हैं — एक primary spermatocyte चार sperms देती है, एक primary oocyte एक ovum plus polar bodies। Ladder दोनों तरफ़ एक जैसी है, और halving meiosis one पर है। और oogenesis जन्म से पहले शुरू होती है, किश्तों में ही पूरी होती है।
Cycle। Follicles Graafian stage तक बनते हैं, फिर surge release करती है। चार phases — menstrual, follicular, ovulatory, luteal। और sources की chain — hypothalamus pings pituitary, ovary plays back।

Development। Zygote, बिना growth वाला cleavage, morula जो बड़ी नहीं है, blastocyst अपने दो हिस्सों के साथ, implantation, pregnancy। Fertilisation ampullary-isthmic junction पर। और sperm ही sex तय करता है।
Placenta एक पुल है और एक gland। Oxygen और खाना अंदर, carbon dioxide और waste बाहर, umbilical cord से। और C H a P L e R — h C G, h P L, relaxin, pregnancy-only तिकड़ी, जिसमें relaxin ovary से।
Germ layers। Ectoderm त्वचा और nerves के लिए, mesoderm muscle और bone और blood के लिए, endoderm linings और आँत की glands के लिए। और gestation लगभग नौ महीने, दिल एक महीने पर।

<excited>और समापन। Parturition positive feedback है — reflex, oxytocin, तेज़ contractions, और oxytocin, delivery। फिर colostrum, antibodies से भरपूर, नवजात के लिए passive immunity। यही है Human Reproduction, पूरा। जाओ और marks ले आओ।
